description: FastAPI security/authentication module implementing JWT token-based auth with user models, token creation, and protected routes.

classes.name: Token
classes.description: Model representing an access token with token string and type.

classes.name: TokenData
classes.description: Model for token payload data, mainly username.

classes.name: User
classes.description: User data model with optional email, full name, and disabled status.

classes.name: UserInDB
classes.description: User model extended with hashed password, used internally.

methods.name: verify_password
methods.description: Verifies a plain password against a hashed password.

methods.name: get_password_hash
methods.description: Generates a hash for a given password.

methods.name: get_user
methods.description: Retrieves a user from the database by username.

methods.name: authenticate_user
methods.description: Authenticates user credentials against the database.

methods.name: create_access_token
methods.description: Creates a JWT access token with optional expiration.

methods.name: get_current_user
methods.description: Dependency that retrieves and validates the current user from token.

methods.name: get_current_active_user
methods.description: Checks if the current user is active (not disabled).

methods.name: login_for_access_token
methods.description: Endpoint to authenticate user and return access token.

methods.name: read_users_me
methods.description: Endpoint to get current user's info.

methods.name: read_own_items
methods.description: Endpoint to get items owned by current user.
